Q2: 'The Great Siege', which the caption in frame 23 shows as '1779 — The Great Siege'. Camps of tents and a trench or siege line appear on the land side, and ships gather in the bay, so it is a siege of the Rock by land and sea.
Q3: Not sure. The pictures never show hunger directly. A ship arrives in frames 36-38 and ships are blockading in 43-47, which hints that supplies are cut off. Nothing shows starving people or empty stores.
Q4: Ships. A fleet of ships sails toward the town around 18 Jan 1780 (frame 47), and a single ship arrives in Oct 1780 (frame 52). The pictures never show it relieving anyone or unloading supplies, so this is only suggested.
